title: StackKit Advanced change-set create result v2
description: Data of the stackkit.command-result/v1 envelope of a successful `stackkit advanced change-set create`: a summary of the stored stackkit.advanced-change-set/v2 record (stackkit-advanced-change-set-v2.schema.json). It shares the record's schemaVersion. Pass changeSetId to --change-set and the sha256 of the stored file at path to --expect-sha256.

path.description: Stored record path relative to the workspace.

affectedStacks.description: Terramate stacks the change set touches, in stack graph run order.
